thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 ALERT — INC-2026-0423-01: Potential PII retention exposure detected for tenant vectra-bank (VPC: vectra-prod, pool: delta-7). Paging on-call SRE. Automated rule: redaction_pipeline_failure + retention_write_after_failover. Please respond in thread.

sara_ong: taking this — Sara O. oncall now, grabbing context.

brad_lee: oncall here, pulling logs. Maria, please loop CS/AM. What triggered the alert?

sara_ong: alert history shows a failover on delta-7 at node restart -> cache flush -> write to persistent store. Redaction pipeline appears to have dropped a batch. I have a short sample that shows account-like strings in traces (sanitized here):

```
[2026-04-23T14:05:12Z] tenant=vectra request_id=abc123 trace="charge attempt acct=4111111111111111 resp=DECLINE"
[2026-04-23T14:05:13Z] tenant=vectra redaction_status=FAILED stage=post-persist
```

brad_lee: not good. probable race where persistence happened before redaction finished during failover. First action: isolate tenant to stop any external log forwarding and prevent further writes to long-term retention. Running isolation now.

brad_lee: (to ops-bot) `servicectl disable-forwarding --tenant vectra` && `apictl tenants isolate vectra --reason "incident INC-2026-0423-01"`

ops-bot: Action queued: disable-forwarding for tenant vectra. ETA ~ 30s.

maria_gomez: CS note — Maria here. I’ve pinged Jay (acctmgr) and prepped a holding message for Vectra Bank. They are enterprise, strict retention / notification clauses — legal wants to be looped before we share anything.

nina_khan: Legal — Nina K. We need: timeline of events, sample logs, confirmation that no external access occurred, and a proposed path to produce only minimally necessary redacted artifacts. If we need to export raw logs for customer legal hold we must get written consent and sign off. Also inform DPO.

lee_park: Security — Treat as potential breach until proven otherwise. Do not share raw logs externally. If internal engineers need access for triage, use the sealed-access workflow and audit everything. Notify CISO if we confirm exfiltration.

brad_lee: isolation commands applied, disabling forwarding now. Also starting a forced re-redaction pass for the last 2 hours to reprocess any writes that might have bypassed redaction:

```
curl -s -X POST "https://infra.internal/api/v1/tenants/vectra/actions/force_redact" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SERVICE_TOKEN" \
  -d '{"since":"-2h","dry_run":false}'
```

ops-bot: Action succeeded: forwarding disabled for tenant vectra at 2026-04-23T14:12:07Z.

sara_ong: handoff — I'm going to run a cluster-level check on the redaction pipeline logs and step out for a 20m break. Brad, take lead and update on progress. I'll rejoin for postmortem.

brad_lee: taking lead. force-redact job started, processing recent writes. Current progress: ~20% after first 5m; estimated completion 30–40m depending on queue size. Will surface any lines that fail redaction.

maria_gomez: drafting holding message for Vectra: short ack, mitigation in progress, no evidence of external access so far, will follow up with timeline. Jay copied. Any phrasing to avoid?

nina_khan: Legal guidance — In holding message avoid definitive statements about data types until we fully triage. Use: "we are investigating an internal logging pipeline issue that may have led to retention of unredacted traces; mitigation is underway; we will provide a timeline and next steps." Do not attach logs. If Vectra asks for raw archive, we need a signed waiver and SOW amendment.

lee_park: Security note — we should treat this as a confirmed logging control failure (severity escalated) and prepare breach checklist locally in case later steps require customer notification under their SLA or local regs.

brad_lee: force-redact produced a small set of failures — 18 records failed automated redaction. Pulling them into a sealed container for legal review. Preparing minimal diffs (redacted) for Nina to confirm scope.

sara_ong: confirming chain-of-custody steps: create s3://redwood-secure/incidents/INC-2026-0423-01/vectra/ with server-side encryption + legal_hold tag; only legal + security + oncall have access. Do not include raw PII in shared folders.

brad_lee: creating bucket/folder now and uploading redacted diffs. Link (internal): https://internal-s3/redwood-secure/INC-2026-0423-01 (redacted samples only)

nina_khan: Received sample. Initial review: redaction algorithm missed card-like substrings in one class of trace. We need a formal exception record: retention/redaction exception form + sign-off from DPO for any internal access. If customer requests full logs, require written customer consent and a scoped forensic export process — legal will draft the consent template.

acctmgr_jay: Jay (AM) — notified Vectra POC. Customer asked: "Can you share the affected time window and whether card numbers appeared in logs?" I recommended holding response per legal template.

maria_gomez: I'll send the holding message now per Nina's wording and escalate that we will provide a timeline within 4 hours.

brad_lee: ETA update: force-redact at ~65% now, failures being triaged. No signs of external access in outgoing network logs. Will continue to monitor and update.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — INC-2026-0423-01: mitigation in progress; status P1; assigned: brad_lee; last action: force-redact job running; forwarding disabled. Next update in 30m or on completion.

nina_khan: Legal final note for this phase — preserve all related artifacts, log a retention exception record, and prepare an internal memo documenting decision path for any deviation from standard retention. If any employee copies raw logs for triage, record who, when, and why.

brad_lee: logged actions and artifacts to ticket RED-5871; uploaded redacted sample and runbook steps. Will follow up with timeline + RCA draft after full processing. Leaving this thread open for updates. :eyes:

maria_gomez: thanks everyone. I’ll coordinate customer comms after legal ok. -maria

sara_ong: rejoining briefly — nice work. Brad, handoff to next oncall at +40m if not resolved. I’ll join postmortem. :thumbsup:

brad_lee: copying final checklist here: isolated tenant, forwarding disabled, force-redact started, sealed artifact created for legal, CS notified, AM engaged. Continuing triage.

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0423-01 remains open — escalation channel incident-ops created.

brad_lee: will post postmortem link when ready. -brad
